spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4)
spacing_and_layout.bilingual_rtl_strategy: CRITICAL: Use Tailwind logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, text-start, text-end, border-e) exclusively. Do NOT use left/right properties like pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-. Rely on HTML dir attribute to flip layout.

components.cards: Cardless or subtle 1px border. Background #FFFFFF, border-border, max rounded-md. Strict padding p-4 to p-6.
components.tables: Dense tables. text-sm. Hover states on rows (hover:bg-gray-50 hover:text-black). Sticky headers. Sortable columns.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-md. Primary: bg-[#002DF5] text-white hover:bg-blue-800. Alert: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white.
components.navigation: Sticky top header, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-gray-200. Must have language toggle (EN/AR).
components.charts: Recharts. Use sharp lines, monochrome base with signal colors (Red for price drop, Blue for velocity).

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant. High contrast on all text.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='lang-toggle-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts heavily relying on CSS logical properties (start/end) for seamless RTL support.
Implement language context to dynamically switch `dir='ltr'` and `dir='rtl'` on the root element.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrapper if it hinders strict 1px grid borders. Build custom dense tables.
Never use `pl-` or `pr-` classes. ALWAYS use `ps-` and `pe-`.
Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` for dense dashboard icons.
Use Recharts for the Price History and Velocity charts on the Product Detail side panel.
Date picker must use Shadcn, but customize it to fit the high-contrast Swiss theme.
All prices must be formatted in SAR (Saudi Riyal).
All components must be written as .js files, not .tsx files.
Integrate data-testid attributes for QA automation testing.
